mission: Learn and execute relationships between human missions and different visual control surfaces without modifying the host software.
software_role: Avolites and grandMA3 are surface adapters and test domains, not the training curriculum.

mathematical_core.affordance_node: v = (role, region, state, gesture_set, feedback_set, preconditions)
mathematical_core.mission_case: c = (mission, source_graph, target_graph, context, relation, gesture_transform, feedback, loss)
mathematical_core.mission_mapping: T(m, context, G_source, G_target) -> {preconditions, target_gestures, feedback, loss}
mathematical_core.learned_loss: lambda_relation * cross_entropy(relation_prediction, relation_label) + lambda_embedding * contrastive_distance(source_mission, target_mission) + lambda_feedback * binary_cross_entropy(feedback_prediction, observed_feedback)
mathematical_core.hard_rule: A high score never bypasses a Windows or physical-output safety gate.

live_show_language.purpose: Compare A and B by the live-show behavior they produce, not by software names or internal objects.
live_show_language.principle: A function is equivalent only when its mission and performance signature remain equivalent under the same context.
live_show_language.warning: Frequency is interpreted as rate of change or modulation when appropriate; not every function must be forced into an audio metaphor.

signature_axes.meaning: pulse, subdivision, repetition or event spacing
speed of change, modulation or recurrence
attack, hold, decay and release behavior
magnitude or intensity of the resulting change
relative offset between elements or repeated events
how many elements act at once
distribution through order, grid, wings, paths or regions
how long the result remains active or reusable
whether the function stores a snapshot or a rule
how the operator knows the mission occurred

live_show_language.signature_vector: L(f, context) = [onset, rhythm, rate, envelope, amplitude, phase, density, spatial_topology, persistence, causality, memory_behavior, feedback]
live_show_language.trajectory_model: S_f(t) = [selection(t), value(t), spatial_state(t), energy(t), active_control(t), feedback(t)]

equivalence_rules.A_equals_B: same mission + same critical axes + D <= tau_common + observed feedback matches
equivalence_rules.A_approximately_equals_B: same mission + perceptual signature close + noncritical loss is visible
equivalence_rules.A_maps_to_B: same mission but different decomposition, timing, or gesture sequence
equivalence_rules.A_not_equals_B: different mission, critical axis conflict, or D >= tau_diff

live_show_language.learning_rule: LEARNING learns the live-show signature and its translation; host labels are evidence, not the semantic target.

canonical_lighting_algebra.purpose: Represent Avolites and grandMA3 as different operators over the same lighting system.

fixtures.attributes: A = {Intensity, Pan, Tilt, Red, Green, Blue, ...}

patch_and_values.important_distinction: P maps an attribute to its DMX address; it does not contain the live value.
patch_and_values.value_function: V: F x A x T -> value_domain

sixteen_bit.note: coarse/fine order is part of the fixture personality and must be observed

example.meaning: fixture f_3 intensity is assigned to channel 127

universe_state.final_output: D_out(t) = Merge(D_sources(t), priority, HTP_LTP, worlds, filters)
universe_state.comparison_rule: Compare final observed output when the mission is physical equivalence.

canonical_language.tuple: L = (U, F, A, P, S, pi, G, V, T)

console_operators.not_required: L_A and L_B need not have the same objects, names or internal procedure

equivalence_levels.physical_exact: D_A_out(t) == D_B_out(t) over the comparison interval
equivalence_levels.physical_tolerant: distance(D_A_out(t), D_B_out(t)) <= epsilon over the comparison interval
equivalence_levels.temporal: same output trajectory after permitted time_warp
equivalence_levels.interaction: same mission but different control path
equivalence_levels.structural: same canonical state and dependency representation
equivalence_levels.rule: Never call interaction or structural similarity physical equality without output evidence

distribution_operator.B_form: V_i = g(pi(i), x_i, y_i, phase_i, context)
distribution_operator.interpretation: B may contain more structural variables; equivalence must compare the resulting trajectory, not the parameter count.

state_or_rule.equivalence: A stored state and a recalculating rule are equal only for a defined context and observed output interval.

learn: conditions under which A and B are physically equivalent
loss when one representation has extra variables
learning_target.required_evidence: DMX trajectory or another explicitly measured output, plus context and timing

variables.mission: human goal expressed as an abstract operation
variables.primitive: select, modify, store, recall, trigger, release, inspect, navigate
variables.source_graph: detected or declared affordance graph of source
variables.target_graph: detected or declared affordance graph of target
variables.source_gesture: mouse, keyboard or ordered gesture sequence
variables.target_gesture: translated target gesture or native invocation
variables.source_context: active page, layer, selection, focus and mode
variables.target_context: target page, layer, selection, focus and mode
variables.semantic_score: match between mission and target affordance
variables.visual_score: match between visual evidence and affordance region
variables.feedback_score: match between observed and expected result
variables.risk_score: potential harm from a wrong or unreversible action
variables.loss: state or meaning not preserved by translation
variables.foreground_hwnd: actual foreground window at execution time
variables.dpi_context: process or per-monitor DPI awareness context
variables.ui_automation_tree: available semantic UIA elements and patterns
variables.capture_state: capture permission, item identity and frame freshness
variables.output_state: known state of physical or simulated output
variables.latency_ms: time from input to observed feedback
variables.mapping_age: time since mapping was last verified

constants.mission_primitives: fixed initial vocabulary; expandable only by a labeled case
constants.minimum_feedback_requirement: one target-state observation after every write-like action

phase_0_seed.name: deterministic mission grammar
phase_0_seed.content: mission primitives, relation labels, gesture grammar, safety gates
phase_0_seed.purpose: make the prototype executable before learning

phase_1_cases.name: supervised mission cases
phase_1_cases.sample: source frame + target frame + mission label + relation label + gesture + observed feedback
negative_samples: correct target region with wrong hierarchy
phase_1_cases.promotion: a case becomes reusable only after observed feedback or human confirmation

phase_2_embedding.name: mission similarity representation
phase_2_embedding.base_encoder: small offline vision-language or visual encoder, frozen initially
phase_2_embedding.fine_tuning: optional lightweight adapter only after enough verified cases
phase_2_embedding.goal: retrieve similar missions without teaching complete host manuals

phase_3_relation.name: relation classifier
phase_3_relation.method: supervised classifier over structured features and embeddings
phase_3_relation.execution: classifier proposes; deterministic safety gate disposes

phase_4_active_learning.name: bounded active learning
phase_4_active_learning.method: propose only reversible or observe-only cases
phase_4_active_learning.prohibited: self-approve a new route or self-enable physical output

capture.preferred: Windows.Graphics.Capture for a user-selected application window
capture.known_effect: system may draw a yellow capture border
capture.fallback: Desktop Duplication or calibrated screenshot path

semantic_observation.preferred: UI Automation element tree and control patterns
semantic_observation.limit: custom controls may expose no provider or incomplete patterns

input.post_message_limit: window-scoped messages may not trigger low-level hooks or raw-key-state consumers

overlay.on: layered_topmost window captures input only inside verified mission hit regions
overlay.peek: show target surface, remove transformed hit map, mark corresponding target region

integrity.elevated_target: do_not_auto_elevate; require signed UIAccess build or use a native semantic route
integrity.secure_desktop: never automate UAC, LogonUI or secure-attention surfaces

prototype_scope.neural_model_requirement: none_for_first_prototype; add frozen encoder after verified cases exist
prototype_scope.success_condition: same mission, transformed visual surface, transformed input, observed feedback, zero host modification

titan.runtime_observation: Titan services were stopped and no listener was active during inventory
local_graphics_evidence: Titan Go and Simulator also contain SkiaSharp and CefSharp.Wpf

grandma3.runtime_observation: onPC executable and separate web_daemon package present
grandma3.interpretation: web_daemon graphics components are not treated as proof that the main grandMA3 UI is rendered by CEF
